desc:
Welcome to Hanto! 👾

Hanto is a survival game featuring nextbots where you must run, dodge, and escape before they catch you, but watch out… some nextbots have unique abilities that make the chase even more dangerous. Survive as long as you can against the nextbots; the longer you last, the more rewards you earn! 🕑

• Earn coins 💰

• Buy awesome items and customize your look with trails, nametags, and more! 💣

• Earn XP, level up, and get rewards ⏫

• Master the challenging special rounds to earn double rewards ✨

• And much more ⭐

Keybinds (PC):
〈Q〉Store 🛍️
〈P〉Settings ⚙️
〈Y〉Streaks 🔥
〈G〉Emotes 🕺💃
〈T〉Nextbots Info 📋

The game is still in development, so it may contain bugs.

Thanks for playing ❤️
